gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.376642 45.350384)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1100 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH park_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.376642, 45.350384), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevated_raster AS (
  SELECT rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.376642, 45.350384), 4326), 4326)
  )
),
elevated_cells AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1)).*
  FROM elevated_raster
  WHERE ST_Value(rast, 1, (ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1)).geom) > 1100
),
nearest_cell AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geometry, c.geom::geometry)) AS min_distance
  FROM park_point p, elevated_cells c
)
SELECT min_distance AS distance_meters FROM nearest_cell;
